stated_size_criteria.sentence: Marion Park is a Chicago-based private investment firm that acquires management, family or founder-owned business services companies generating $1 to $5 million of EBITDA. We have nearly twenty years of experience investing alongside strong management teams in high-quality service companies looking to accelerate growth. We understand what it takes to invest in, partner with, and grow service companies whose people are its core asset.
Marion Park invests in lower middle market business services companies. The firm targets management, family or founder-owned US-based businesses generating $1 to $5 million of EBITDA .
